title: Alibi and Cipher
author: Astrid Underhill
blurb: Wren Ashgrove, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
